attchmntText: Pyramid Technoplast Limited has informed the Exchange about Link of Recording
voiceSummary: Pyramid Technoplast Limited has uploaded the audio and video recordings of its earnings conference call held on November 06, 2026. The call discussed the Un-Audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The recordings are available on the company website. The audio link is https://pyramidtechnoplast.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/e.-Earnings-Audio-Call_Q2_FY_2026-27.mp3. The video link is https://pyramidtechnoplast.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/f.-Earnings-Video-Call_Q2_FY_2026-27.mp4. This filing is in compliance with Regulation 30 read with Para A of Part A of Schedule III of the SEBI Listing Regulations, 2015. The notice was signed by Chandrika Khatri, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, in Mumbai.

attchmntText: Pyramid Technoplast Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Pyramid Technoplast Limited filed a notice with the National Stock Exchange of India and BSE Limited regarding the newspaper publication of its Un-Audited Financial Results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. The results were approved by the Board of Directors at their meeting held on November 06, 2026. The extracts were published on November 07, 2026, in the Financial Express and Mumbai Lakshadeep. The filing was signed by Chandrika Khatri, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer. The document also contains unrelated text in Devanagari script referencing Neogen Chemicals Limited, but the primary subject is Pyramid Technoplast Limited.
